heltec-v3.notes: Standard TimingPod V2 (RFID + Lidar pods, TOFSense-F2 Mini)

timingpod-v2demo.notes: Demo pods with Benewake TFmini-S IIC LiDAR (5V, I2C addr 0x10)

timingpod-v2demo-uart.notes: Demo pods with Benewake TFmini-S read over UART (green TXD -> GPIO42, white RXD -> GPIO41). Skips the Wire1 I2C scan, which the other builds hang on.

beacon-esp32c3.notes: Published separately in firmware/manifest-beacon.json — the beacon is its own product on its own 3.x stream, and a 3.x entry in this 2.x pod manifest is refused by the desktop's line guard. Kept here as a version marker for older desktops only.
